text.autoconfig.simplequalityoflife.opti:
Bundled sub-mod: weather switch and rain
density, settings in Simple Weather's own
config. Default: true.

Bundled sub-mod: the Simple style for
Vanilla container screens, settings in
Simple Interfaces' own config. Default: true.

Bundled sub-mod: crawling, autowalk,
ladder speed and Frost Walker on powder
snow, settings in Simple Movement's own
config. Default: true.

Bundled sub-mod: full-durability bonus,
Thrift, anvil repair cost and furnace lava
fill, settings in Simple Tools's own
config. Default: true.

Bundled sub-mod: farmland protection,
grass cutting and hoe harvesting, settings
in Simple Farming's own config. Default:
true.

Bundled sub-mod: muted mobs, named babies
and gold-tolerant piglins, settings in
Simple Mob Manners's own config. Default:
true.

Bundled sub-mod: repeat vault rewards
after a cooldown, settings in Simple
Loot's own config. Default: true.
simplequalityoflife.config.title: Simple Quality of Life — Server settings
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.1.title: Simple Quality of Life
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.1: Bundles seven sub-mods with one switch each: weather, interfaces, loot, mob manners, farming, tools and movement.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.2.title: Commands
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.2: Owner-level /simplequalityoflife submod <weather|interfaces|loot|mobmanners|farming|tools|movement> <true|false> switches a bundled sub-mod;
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.3.title: Commands
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.3: the former tweak commands moved with their features into the
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.4.title: Commands
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.4: sub-mods (/simpleloot, /simplemobmanners, /simplefarming, /simpletools, /simplemovement). Changes are saved to config/simplequalityoflife.json.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.5.title: Disable weather
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.5: disableWeather (default false, server) clears rain and thunder and skips weather progression.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.6.title: Rain density
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.6: clientRainParticleDensity is a local visual preference, default 20, bounded 0–100: thins rain in the air, ground particles and rain sounds; it never changes server weather.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.7.title: Vault cooldown
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.7: A player may loot a vault again after vaultCooldownDays, default 100 Minecraft days, bounded 1–36500. The original SimpleBuildingLootTimes UUID-to-time map is retained.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.8.title: Vault cooldown
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.8: Missing timestamps on already rewarded entries start a cooldown rather than granting free repeat loot; backwards time does not unlock rewards.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.9.title: Commands
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.9: Owner-level /simpleloot vaults cooldown <days> and /simpleloot vaults repeat <true|false>; changes are saved to config/simpleloot.json.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.10.title: Mute mobs
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.10: mutedEntities selects entity IDs. Names ending in _mute or _shhh are silent by default. Lists accept at most 64 nonempty distinct entries of at most 64 characters. Existing Vanilla silent state remains effective.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.11.title: Permanent babies
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.11: Every 100 ticks, named ageable mobs ending in _baby or _small are set to age -24000. The source also makes named adults young again; this behavior is preserved. Removing the suffix allows aging again.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.12.title: Piglin gold equipment
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.12: Gold armor trims or a golden sword, spear, pickaxe, axe, shovel, or hoe in either hand count as
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.13.title: Piglin gold equipment
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.13: safe equipment. The two switches default true. This does not prevent anger caused by attacking or opening containers.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.14.title: Commands
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.14: Owner-level /simplemobmanners muteSuffixes, babySuffixes and mutedEntities list/add/remove/clear; piglinsIgnoreGoldTrims and piglinsIgnoreGoldTools <true|false>.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.15.title: Commands
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.15: Changes are saved to config/simplemobmanners.json. Formerly Simple Creatures: /simplecreatures still works as an alias with a hint, config/simplecreatures.json and the super-mod switch are taken over once.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.16.title: Feather Falling farmland protection
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.16: Feather Falling boots prevent trampling. This complements SimpleBuilding Breeze head protection. Enabled by preventFarmlandTrampleWithFeatherFalling, default true.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.17.title: Hoe harvest and replant
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.17: Main-hand hoes harvest mature wheat, carrots, potatoes, beetroot, nether wart, and cocoa. One seed is taken from the actual loot; survival costs one durability.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.18.title: Hoe harvest and replant
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.18: Server reach, world border, spawn protection, build rights, loader break vetoes, and a four-tick action limit are enforced.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.19.title: Sharpness cuts vegetation
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.19: Sharpness III or higher on a sword or axe clears explicit small vegetation overlapping the attacked entity. Sneaking disables it. At most 27 positions within 4.5 blocks are considered;
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.20.title: Sharpness cuts vegetation
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.20: loader break vetoes and action cooldown apply. The matching vegetation outline is hidden.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.21.title: Commands
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.21: Owner-level /simplefarming farmlandProtect, hoeHarvest and sharpnessCut <true|false>; changes are saved to config/simplefarming.json.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.22.title: Furnace lava fill
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.22: Either hand inserts one lava bucket into a furnace, blast furnace, or smoker with an empty fuel slot or one leftover empty bucket. Locked furnaces and sneaking are excluded. Survival consumes the lava bucket;
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.23.title: Furnace lava fill
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.23: an existing empty bucket is returned exactly once. SimpleBuilding furnace subclasses are supported through the Vanilla interface.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.24.title: Durability bonus
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.24: Damageable held Vanilla and mod tools above the durability threshold can gain attack damage and mining speed. The default multiplier is 1.0 (no bonus), with a server-enforced range of 1–1.5. The threshold defaults to 80% (range 80–100%).
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.25.title: Durability bonus
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.26.title: Thrift
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.26: Enchantment for every item with durability, levels I-III: +1/3 maximum durability per level, level III doubles it. Not combinable with Mending; Unbreaking still works.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.27.title: Thrift
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.27: Anvil repair with material restores a quarter of the (larger) maximum per item, so the same number of items as without the enchantment repairs it fully.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.28.title: Thrift
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.28: Enchanting table, trades and loot like other non-treasure enchantments. The id stays simplequalityoflife:thrift, so
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.29.title: Thrift
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.29: enchanted items from older worlds keep it; it also works with the sub-mod switched off.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.30.title: Repairing keeps the anvil cost
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.30: Repairing with material, combining two items without new enchantments or renaming keeps the higher anvil cost of the inputs instead of raising it. Only a change of enchantments raises it like vanilla.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.31.title: Repairing keeps the anvil cost
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.32.title: Commands
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.32: Owner-level /simpletools fullDurabilityBonus, anvilRepairKeepsCost and furnaceLava <true|false>; changes are saved to config/simpletools.json.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.33.title: Soulbound
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.33: Treasure enchantment, one level, for everything that can carry the Curse of Vanishing (the two exclude each other).
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.34.title: Soulbound
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.34: An item with Soulbound never drops on death - also in PvP and Hardcore - and is back in the same slot after the respawn, with at most 50 durability left (min(current, 50)). Book only:
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.35.title: Soulbound
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.35: never from the enchanting table, librarians or random loot; a wandering trader sells one book for 24-32 diamonds now and then (5 % per trader), and End City treasure chests hold one very rarely (2 %). Rarer than Mending.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.36.title: Soulbound
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.36: Applying it at the anvil always costs the full 35 levels; the grindstone removes it.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.37.title: Death Vault
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.37: Crafted block (obsidian, eye of ender, soul sand or soul soil, chest). It shows what became of each item dropped at your last death, colour coded with a legend:
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.38.title: Death Vault
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.38: still lying (green), picked up by you (blue) or by another player (red, the name shows on hover), burned in lava, fire or by a cactus (orange), despawned (gray), fallen into the void (purple), gone another way (yellow).
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.39.title: Death Vault
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.39: A lying item has a bar like a durability bar: how much of its five minutes is left. If its chunk is not loaded the timer stands and the field shows a pause mark. Buying lost items back with an offering is a future feature:
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.40.title: Death Vault
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.40: the code stays, option deathVaultRedeem is off by default.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.41.title: (with Simple Money) Money bills as offering
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.41: When Simple Money is installed, its money bills count like diamonds in the Death Vault offering slot (optional tag entry, nothing changes without the mod).
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.42.title: Manual crawling
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.42: P or /crawl sets the synchronized swimming pose. Jump exits. Commands are limited to one change per 10 ticks; spectators and passengers are refused.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.43.title: Auto-walk
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.43: R toggles ordinary forward input only when the server enables enableAutowalk (default false). Opening a screen or leaving the world stops it. A click sound signals the change. It adds no speed or reach.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.44.title: Auto-walk
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.44: The autowalk and crawl key bindings of Simple QoL are taken over once.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.45.title: Climbing and sliding
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.45: Climbing speed defaults to 0.4 blocks/tick (range 0.2–0.4). Slide speed defaults to 0.8 (range 0.15–0.8). CAMERA requires looking down and sneaking; ALWAYS requires looking down without sneaking.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.46.title: Climbing and sliding
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.46: The server rejects excess vertical movement on climbable blocks with a bounded latency allowance.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.47.title: Frost Walker on powder snow
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.47: Frost Walker permits walking on powder snow. Enabled by frostWalkerWalkOnPowderSnow, default true.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.48.title: Commands
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.48: /crawl is available to players. Owner-level /simplemovement autowalk and frostWalkerSnow <true|false> and ladderSpeed <0.2-0.4>; changes are saved to config/simplemovement.json.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.49.title: Style comparison switch
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.49: In development, or when showStyleToggle is enabled, the button and unbound key toggle all SimpleLib-based screens between the Simple style and Vanilla.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.50.title: Simple container style
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.50: Chest, barrel, ender chest, shulker box, hopper, dispenser/dropper and crafter screens and the mount inventories (horse, donkey, mule, llama, camel, nautilus) get a box in the block's color around the
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.51.title: Simple container style
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.51: container slots and a light box around your inventory, with sunk rounded slots. Client only; the server needs nothing.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.52.title: Simple style for workstations
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.52: Crafting table, furnace, blast furnace, smoker, brewing stand, beacon and enchanting table screens get the Simple style in the block's color. Client only; the server needs nothing.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.53.title: Simple style for anvil, loom & co.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.53: Anvil, grindstone, stonecutter, loom, cartography table, smithing table, villager trading and your own inventory get the Simple style:
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.54.title: Simple style for anvil, loom & co.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.54: a box in the block's color, the big result slot, engraved symbols (plus, arrow, grinding
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.55.title: Simple style for anvil, loom & co.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.55: wheel, XP) instead of Vanilla's pictures, raised tiles for recipes, patterns and offers. Client only.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.56.title: Linked containers
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.56: Sneak + right-click a container with an empty main hand to mark it (a double chest counts as one); dust particles at your hand show the mark.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.57.title: Linked containers
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.57: The next chest or GUI you open (crafting table, furnace, anvil …) shows the marked container above it,
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.58.title: Linked containers
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.58: sharing your inventory. Shift-click moves marked → second GUI, else inventory; inventory → second GUI, else the marked container.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.59.title: Linked containers
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.59: The mark ends beyond linkedContainerRange (default 64, range 8–128), in another dimension, in an unloaded chunk, when the block is gone, on logout or death, or with another sneak + right-click on it.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.60.title: Linked containers
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.60: Claims and locks are checked. The recipe book still only counts your inventory.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.61.title: Easy shulker boxes and ender chests
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.61: Right-click a shulker box (any color, also SimpleBuilding tier boxes) or an ender chest in the air, or right-click it on its own inventory slot, to open it without placing it.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.62.title: Easy shulker boxes and ender chests
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.62: The item stays locked in its slot while open; every change is written into the box at once. Shulker boxes do not fit inside. Not from the creative inventory tab. Switches:
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.63.title: Easy shulker boxes and ender chests
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.64.title: Settings
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.64: More settings are in the mod's config screen.
quests.simplequalityoflife.start.title: Welcome to Simple Quality of Life
quests.simplequalityoflife.start.welcome: Craft or pick up a crafting table and claim the Simple Quality of Life Guide as a reward. You can also craft it from a book and a chest.
